subject: Television & Streaming
title: Television Enters Every Home
description: A quick win: understand Television Enters Every Home.

hook.text: In 1950, only 9 percent of American homes had a television. By 1960, that number was 90 percent.

buildup.text: Television replaced radio as the dominant medium. Families gathered nightly around a single screen in the living room.

discovery.text: For the first time, millions of people watched the same images at the same time.

twist.text: That shared experience meant television could shape public opinion faster than any medium before it—for better or worse.

climax.text: The living room became a window to the world.

punchline.text: A box in the living room rewired how a nation thinks.

quiz.question: What percentage of American homes had a TV by 1960?
